blocks.html: Fuel-oil storage and piping systems shall comply with the requirements of this chapter, Appendix C and, to the extent not otherwise provided for in this code, shall comply with the requirements of NFPA 31. All above-ground and underground storage facilities shall also comply with the requirements of the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation's Petroleum Bulk Storage Code.
